techs.name: Gramophone Resonance
techs.notes: Her Attack (cost: none). Ferric Rattle: +25% vs metal and hitches their next action. 8-frame rings.

techs.name: Ferro Graviton
techs.notes: Magnetizes; pull-in 1.6 m (AoE 1.0 -> 1.6). +30% if Lucca was asked at this camp. Vesper's prism doubles the shard count. Lv3 leaves a mercury pool: the next FERRO hit +20%.

techs.name: Mercury Pulse
techs.notes: Costs the mercury orb (recharges after 2 of her turns, or instantly in an amber pool / Static Noise pile; written as cooldown_turns 2). Radius +1.0 as Centaur. Reveals every weakness inside (the Lucca Lens). Mercury SLOW and magnetic bind. Along a tether: double range and an amber DoT.

techs.name: Wire Loom Mend
techs.notes: Restores HP and up to 10% of max-HP ceiling lost this battle. On Crono: +0.6 integrity once per battle. On other copies: removes one hazard status (strips the art-curse). A Lucca ability (Ask prompt).

techs.name: Sound Ring
techs.notes: The party's [SOUND] AoE: shatters Porcelain Choirs. Residual ring for 4 s (+10% amber shard drop). With an ASTRAL hit on R-66Y in one window: the Lullaby Rewind.

techs.name: Gatling Arm
techs.notes: Bipedal Porcelain form only. The 8th hit Magnetizes. Bible flag `R-66Y_Salvaged` is data flag R66Y state Salvaged.

techs.name: Prometheus Overload
techs.notes: Relic ultimate (Prometheus Core), Ch3 choice: once per battle, needs Lucca's consent. 1 detonate + 10 burn ticks. Boost bonus +60%; Cassia-09 then shuts down (next gauge starts at -20); allies within 2 m take 10% max HP. Without consent the Core counts as burned selfishly.
